subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers set aside https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/930 and queue a fresh narrow Feishu fetched-message mention-normalization repair from current main?
rationale: The source-level defect and likely fix boundary are clear, but an open fork PR already claims this issue with closing syntax and uses the same broad head as the closed same-repo PR.

options.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
options.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention adapter, normalization call, and focused Feishu tests from current main.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed fork diff
options.body: Preserve contributor work only if the fork branch can be reduced to the Feishu parser and test changes without unrelated churn.

options.title: Leave to Feishu owner
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Feishu plugin contact to fix manually with live workspace proof when ready.

recommendation.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention adapter, normalization call, and focused Feishu tests from current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is confined to the declared community-maintained Feishu/Lark plugin boundary.
